plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs: SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU.
We will trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to favor income and broad index exposure.
A new position in DDOG will be initiated at 5% as a top-quality name.
This plan aims for steady, low-drawdown performance with a focus on capital preservation.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also limited upside potential. The focus is on stability and protecting your equity.

plan: We will trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
SPY will be trimmed to 23% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
QQQI will be increased to 31% to balance broad index and income exposure.
CRWD will be added to 15% to increase exposure to a quality tech name.
A new position in NVDA will be initiated at 5% based on a strong scanner setup.
This plan aims for risk-first growth, blending broad index, quality tech, and small leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It seeks a blend of stability and growth, with moderate volatility. Expect a more active approach than conservative, but still with an emphasis on managing overall portfolio risk.

plan: SPY will be trimmed to 25% to cure the concentration breach while maintaining broad exposure.
We will add to SOXL (10%), MUU (6%), and METU (6%) to lean into leveraged ETFs.
CRWD will be increased to 15% to concentrate in a high-scoring scanner setup.
A new position in NVDA will be initiated at 8% based on a strong scanner setup.
This plan aims for stretch growth by using leverage and concentrating in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It involves higher leverage and concentration, which amplifies both potential upside and drawdown. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to significant losses quickly if not managed with strict stop discipline.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs: SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU.
High-beta single names CRWD and SNOW will also be sold.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 60% to rotate into income-focused ETFs.
This plan aims for steady monthly distributions with a focus on low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Remember, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
